purpose: Test whether the Nott microglia PLAC-seq substrate is preferentially supported by microglial regulatory chromatin relative to same-study neuronal and oligodendrocyte comparators, before E2 construction and protected outcome inspection.
preconditions_before_fit_test: verify exact source bytes and checksums
determine original genome build and column schema
count rows and unique unordered anchor pairs
independently harmonize to hg38 under C3 and compare to FILER
do not inspect AD-gene enrichment, JEPA target overlap, Morabito protected target-state cis correspondence, or NIH-CARD RNA-ATAC correspondence
fit_question: Does the candidate Nott microglia promoter-contact substrate preferentially align with microglial regulatory accessibility relative to neuron and oligodendrocyte accessibility after controlling genomic opportunity and contact geometry?

primary_comparison.positive_context: microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against microglia accessibility
negative_contexts: same microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against neuron accessibility
same microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against oligodendrocyte accessibility
primary_comparison.paired_structure: the same contact pairs are evaluated against all three accessibility layers

null.primary: promoter-fixed distal shuffle preserving chromosome and empirical promoter-distance distribution, with contact-degree structure preserved where feasible
forbidden: choosing a null to maximize microglia significance
using target genes or disease loci to define null eligibility

pass_fail.primary_requirement: Microglia support must exceed BOTH neuron and oligodendrocyte support under the frozen paired contrast, and observed microglia support must exceed the promoter-fixed shuffled null.
pass_fail.hard_stop: If either neuron or oligodendrocyte materially equals or exceeds microglia after nuisance control, classify NOT_MICROGLIA_FIT_FOR_TARGET_CONSTRUCTION. Do not rescue by restricting to AD loci, target genes or post-hoc contact subsets.
